atlas.text: Store builds only through EAS Build (profiles development, preview, production); no local Xcode archive uploads — Local archives shipped with the wrong bundle version twice. EAS manages credentials and auto-increments buildNumber/versionCode.
eas submit --profile production uploads to App Store Connect (TestFlight) and Google Play internal track; ASC API key stored in EAS secrets
iOS build failed with "Multiple commands produce PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy"; fixed with a config plugin that dedupes privacy manifests
Sürüm numarası app.config.ts içinde semver; runtimeVersion policy "fingerprint", native değişiklik varsa yeni store build şart
Android release build needs org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4g on EAS medium workers or Hermes compile OOMs
JS-only fixes ship as EAS Update OTA to the production channel; anything touching native modules needs a new store build
Update channels: preview -> TestFlight/internal builds, production -> store builds; eas update --branch production --message "..."
OTA update crashed old binaries because a new native module was referenced; we now use runtimeVersion fingerprint so incompatible updates are not delivered
Navigation with expo-router (file-based, app/ directory); typed routes enabled
Deep links: scheme atlas:// and universal links on atlas.travel (apple-app-site-association served by Supabase storage via Cloudflare)
Android back button closed the app from nested trip screens; fixed by using Stack inside each tab instead of a single root Stack
Server state with TanStack Query, local UI state with zustand; no Redux
Persistent storage via react-native-mmkv (src/lib/storage.ts); AsyncStorage removed because it was slow on Android startup
Offline trips list was empty after cold start; added persistQueryClient with the MMKV persister and gcTime 24h
useSessionStore holds the Supabase session; tokens are kept in expo-secure-store, not MMKV
Backend is Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Storage + Edge Functions); no custom server — Small team, needed auth and storage on day one. Edge Functions (Deno) for anything that needs secrets.
Every table has RLS enabled; policies live in supabase/migrations, never created in the dashboard
Regenerate DB types after each migration: supabase gen types typescript --linked > src/types/database.ts
Edge function cold starts were 2s+; moved heavy imports inside the handler and pinned to Deno std deps
supabase start needs Docker running with at least 4GB memory; studio on localhost:54323
Maps use @rnmapbox/maps instead of react-native-maps because offline tile packs are needed for trips abroad
Mapbox download token (RNMapboxMapsDownloadToken) is an EAS secret; the public access token is in EXPO_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN
Map crashed on Android 14 when the screen unmounted during a camera animation; guard with isMounted ref and cancel camera on blur
Push notifications via expo-notifications with the Expo push service; tokens saved in device_tokens table; FCM v1 credentials uploaded to EAS
No notifications on Android 13+: POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission was never requested; now requested after onboarding
iOS push tokens from development builds are sandbox tokens and do not work against production APNs
Localization with i18next + expo-localization; languages tr, en, de; translation files src/i18n/locales/*.json
Çeviri anahtarları ekran bazlı: trips.detail.title; sabit metin JSX içine yazılmaz, lint kuralı i18next/no-literal-string açık
Turkish plurals showed "1 günler"; i18next v23 needs compatibilityJSON v4 and Intl.PluralRules polyfill on Hermes
Unit tests with jest-expo and React Native Testing Library; e2e flows with Maestro in .maestro/ run on EAS for the preview profile
Jest failed on mmkv import (native module); mocked react-native-mmkv in jest.setup.ts
Maestro booking flow is flaky on the iOS 17 simulator because of the keyboard; added hideKeyboard steps
Crash reporting with @sentry/react-native; source maps uploaded by the Sentry Expo plugin during EAS Build; dsn in EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN
Sentry stack traces were minified for OTA updates; need to run sentry-expo-upload-sourcemaps after eas update
Trip list stuttered with 300+ items; replaced FlatList with FlashList and estimatedItemSize 96
Use expo-image (with blurhash placeholders) everywhere instead of the RN Image component
Cold start on low-end Android is 3.4s; biggest cost is loading all locale files eagerly
Styling with NativeWind v4 (Tailwind classes); no styled-components; design tokens in tailwind.config.js
Content went under the Dynamic Island; wrap screens in SafeAreaView from react-native-safe-area-context, not the RN one
Her dokunulabilir öğede accessibilityLabel olmalı; minimum dokunma alanı 44x44
Custom font Inter loaded with expo-font in app/_layout.tsx; splash screen stays until fonts are loaded
App Store rejected 1.4.0 (guideline 5.1.1): account deletion must be possible inside the app; added Settings > Delete account calling the delete-user edge function
Google Play requires targetSdkVersion 34 since Aug 2024; set via expo-build-properties
ASC flagged missing privacy manifest reasons for UserDefaults; declared NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryUserDefaults reason CA92.1
Premium subscription via in-app purchases with RevenueCat (react-native-purchases); entitlements checked with useEntitlement('pro')
IAP sandbox renewals are accelerated (1 month = 5 min); test users created in App Store Connect > Users and Access > Sandbox
Pro badge did not appear after purchase on a second device; RevenueCat webhook now writes the entitlement to profiles.is_pro
Only EXPO_PUBLIC_* variables are bundled in the app; anything secret goes into Supabase Edge Function secrets, never into app.config
No certificate pinning (decided too risky for OTA-updatable apps); HTTPS + Supabase RLS are the security boundary
Package manager for atlas is bun (bun install); expo CLI runs through bunx expo
ESLint flat config with eslint-config-expo + prettier; CI fails on warnings (--max-warnings 0)
Package manager: bun (bun.lockb committed), yarn.lock removed
Session: started offline tile pack download UI; mapbox offlineManager progress events wired, needs cancel button
Session: fixed Turkish plural forms; added Intl.PluralRules polyfill
Session: FlashList migration for trip list; scroll is smooth on Pixel 4a now
Session: hesap silme akışı eklendi (App Store 5.1.1 reddi için), edge function delete-user yazıldı
`bun run test` failed (Cannot find module 'react-native-mmkv') → fixed via jest.setup.ts
`eas build -p ios --profile preview` failed (Multiple commands produce PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy) → fixed via plugins/withPrivacyDedupe.js
`bunx expo run:android` failed (SecurityException: POST_NOTIFICATIONS) → fixed via src/lib/notifications.ts
Product analytics with PostHog (EU cloud); screen views tracked automatically via the expo-router integration
Offline map packs: add cancel + storage usage display in Settings
iOS home screen widget showing the next trip (needs expo-apple-targets)
Trip dates shift by one day for users west of UTC because we parse YYYY-MM-DD with new Date(); use date-fns parseISO + local date
Designs in Figma file "Atlas App v3"; designer is Deniz, components mirror the Figma library names
Forms with react-hook-form + zod resolvers; one zod schema shared with the Supabase edge function input validation
Expo SDK upgrades: run npx expo install --fix and check expo-doctor; never bump react-native manually
Hotel availability comes from the partner API through the booking edge function; responses cached 10 min in the hotel_cache table
Deniz wants the trip detail redesign (bottom sheet with day tabs) in 1.7
Environment per EAS profile: development/preview use the staging Supabase project, production uses prod; set via env in eas.json
All App Store / Play builds go through EAS Build; we never upload archives from local Xcode

global.text: Bana Türkçe cevap ver; kod, yorumlar ve commit mesajları İngilizce olsun
Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, chore:), imperative mood, no emojis
Never force-push to main or master; force-with-lease only on my own feature branches
Küçük PR'ları tercih ederim: 400 satırı geçen değişiklikleri parçalara böl
For Node projects prefer pnpm over npm or yarn unless the repo already uses something else
Run the test suite and the linter before every commit; do not commit with failing tests
Keep code comments short and explain why, not what; no commented-out code
Uzun açıklama yazma, önce kodu göster sonra 2-3 cümle açıklama yeter
In TypeScript prefer type aliases over interfaces except for public library APIs; named exports only, no default exports
Indentation is 2 spaces for JS/TS/JSON/YAML, 4 for Python; LF line endings
My machine is a MacBook Pro M2 (arm64) running macOS 15; shell is fish, terminal is Ghostty
I use OrbStack instead of Docker Desktop; docker compose commands work the same
Git commits are signed with SSH signing (gpg.format ssh), key in 1Password SSH agent
I am in Istanbul (Europe/Istanbul, UTC+3, no DST); schedule cron jobs in this timezone when it's user-facing
If git push hangs, the 1Password SSH agent is waiting for Touch ID approval
Never paste real secrets into code, tests or memory; use .env files that are gitignored and keep .env.example updated
Ask before adding a new runtime dependency; prefer the standard library or what the project already uses
Ask before running destructive commands: rm -rf outside the repo, DROP TABLE, git reset --hard, deleting branches
Production database migrations are never run from my laptop; only through the project's CI/CD pipeline
Do not swallow errors: no empty catch blocks; log with context or rethrow
Editor is Cursor with Vim mode; I also use Claude Code and Codex in the terminal
GitHub CLI (gh) is authenticated; use gh pr create --fill and gh pr checks instead of the web UI
Tickets are in Linear; branch names include the ticket id
Turkish locale gotcha: "i".toUpperCase() in tr-TR gives "İ"; use toLocaleUpperCase('en-US') for identifiers and keys
When parsing date-only strings (YYYY-MM-DD) in JS, new Date() treats them as UTC; use a date library or construct local dates
For Python HTTP prefer httpx over requests (async support, timeouts by default)
Session: set up SSH commit signing with 1Password, updated global gitconfig
`git push` failed (Permission denied (publickey)) → fixed via ~/.ssh/config
When reviewing my code, list problems by severity (blocker, should-fix, nit) and skip praise
Değişken isimlerinde kısaltma kullanma (usr, cfg yerine user, config); boolean'lar is/has/can ile başlasın

kervan.text: Deploy via fly.io from GitHub Actions on every merge to main; no manual flyctl deploy from laptops — We moved off Vercel because image optimisation costs exploded and we needed a long-lived worker for BullMQ. The workflow runs pnpm build, then flyctl deploy --remote-only. Laptop deploys skipped migrations twice.
fly.io app name is kervan-web (region ams), the BullMQ worker runs as a separate process group "worker" in the same fly.toml
Deploy failed with P3009 failed migration; fixed by running prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back on the release_command machine before redeploying
Canlıya çıkmadan önce staging'de (kervan-staging.fly.dev) en az bir smoke test koşulur, cuma 16:00'dan sonra prod deploy yapılmaz
Rollback: flyctl releases list then flyctl deploy --image <previous image ref>; prisma migrations are NOT rolled back automatically, write a down script
Postgres on Neon instead of PlanetScale, because we need foreign keys and Prisma relation mode was too slow on joins
DATABASE_URL must use the Neon pooled host (-pooler) with ?pgbouncer=true&connection_limit=1 in serverless routes; DIRECT_URL is the unpooled host used only by prisma migrate
"too many connections" in dev was caused by hot reload creating a new PrismaClient each time; fixed with the globalThis.prisma singleton in src/server/db.ts
Migration isimleri snake_case ve fiil ile başlar (add_order_status_index); şemayı elle düzenledikten sonra her zaman pnpm db:migrate --name ile migration üret, db push kullanma
Order listing page was slow (1.8s); added composite index on (userId, createdAt desc) — now 40ms
Money is stored as integer kuruş (Int) never Float or Decimal; format with formatTRY() from src/lib/money.ts
pnpm db:seed creates 3 test users (admin@kervan.test / Test1234!) and 200 fake products from prisma/seed.ts
Auth.js (next-auth v5) with database sessions, not JWT, because we need to revoke sessions when a seller is banned
useAuthStore (zustand, src/stores/useAuthStore.ts) only mirrors the server session for client components; never treat it as the source of truth for permissions
Hydration mismatch on header avatar: useAuthStore was persisted to localStorage; fixed by skipHydration and calling rehydrate() inside useEffect in providers.tsx
Google OAuth callback URL must be added for every preview domain; staging uses AUTH_URL=https://kervan-staging.fly.dev
Rol kontrolü sadece sunucuda: requireRole('seller') src/server/rbac.ts içinde; client tarafında rol kontrolü sadece UI gizlemek için
Logout does not clear the cart cookie, so the next user on a shared device sees the previous cart
Payments go through iyzico, not Stripe: Stripe does not onboard Turkish merchants and taksit (installments) is a must-have
iyzico 3DS callback is a POST form to /api/payments/callback; it cannot read our session cookie (SameSite=Lax), so we look up the order by conversationId
Double-charged orders: iyzico retried the callback and we created two payments; fixed with a unique index on Payment.providerPaymentId and an upsert
iyzico sandbox test card 5528790000000008, any future expiry, CVC 123; 3DS SMS code is always 283126 in sandbox
Ödeme tutarlarını iyzico'ya gönderirken kuruşu TL string'e çevir: toIyzicoPrice(12990) -> "129.90"; asla parseFloat ile toplama yapma
Partial refunds for multi-item orders are not implemented; refund.ts only supports full refund
Product search uses Meilisearch (self-hosted on fly, app kervan-search) instead of Postgres full text, because Turkish typo tolerance and facets out of the box
Meilisearch index is synced by the BullMQ job syncSearch on product update; full reindex: pnpm search:reindex (takes ~4 min for 60k products)
Searching "ılık" did not match "ILIK" — set Meilisearch localizedAttributes locales ["tur"] in settings.ts so İ/ı fold correctly
Meili synonyms list includes telefon/cep telefonu/akıllı telefon and kulaklık/headphone; edit settings.ts and run search:settings
UI built with shadcn/ui components copied into src/components/ui; never install another component library, extend with cva variants
Colours only via CSS variables in globals.css (--primary, --muted); no raw hex in className
Product images live on Cloudflare R2 behind images.kervan.com.tr; next/image uses a custom loader (src/lib/images.ts) because fly has no image optimiser
CLS on category pages fixed by giving ProductCard images a fixed aspect-ratio 4/5 and sizes attribute
Dark mode is postponed; next-themes is installed but ThemeProvider forced to light
i18n with next-intl, locales tr (default) and en, URLs prefixed only for en (/en/...); Turkish has no prefix for SEO
Yeni metin eklerken önce messages/tr.json'a ekle, en.json eksikse build uyarı verir ama kırmaz; anahtarlar nokta ile: checkout.summary.total
Dates showed in UTC on server render; fixed by passing timeZone: 'Europe/Istanbul' to next-intl getRequestConfig
Guest cart stored in Upstash Redis keyed by a signed cookie cart_id (TTL 30 days); merged into the DB cart on login
Cart merge duplicated line items when the same variant existed in both carts; now we sum quantities and cap at stock
Stock is reserved only at payment start (15 min hold in StockReservation table), not when adding to cart
Transactional email via Resend, sent from the BullMQ email queue, never inline in a request handler
Email templates are react-email components in emails/; preview with pnpm email:dev on port 3001
Order confirmation mails went to spam at Outlook until we added the Resend DKIM CNAMEs on the kervan.com.tr zone
BullMQ worker entrypoint is src/jobs/worker.ts; it needs REDIS_URL pointing at the fly Upstash instance, not the Upstash REST URL
Jobs stuck in "active" after deploy: worker was killed without graceful shutdown; added SIGTERM handler calling worker.close() and kill_timeout = 60 in fly.toml
Unit tests with Vitest next to the file (*.test.ts), e2e with Playwright in e2e/; every bug fix gets a regression test
Playwright e2e uses a throwaway Neon branch created in e2e/global-setup.ts and deleted after the run; needs NEON_API_KEY in CI
Flaky checkout e2e: waited for networkidle which never fires with analytics; switched to waiting on the "Siparişiniz alındı" heading
Coverage threshold set to 70% lines for src/server only; UI components excluded
CI uses pnpm store cache + turbo remote cache (Vercel token TURBO_TOKEN still used for cache only)
CI broke with ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE after a renovate PR; we now run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and renovate does lockfile maintenance weekly
PR'lar en az bir onay ve yeşil CI olmadan merge edilmez; squash merge, başlık conventional commit formatında
Errors go to Sentry (EU region) with tracesSampleRate 0.1 in prod; session replay disabled because of KVKK
Server logs via pino to stdout, fly forwards them to Better Stack; use log.child({ orderId }) in payment code
Never log TC kimlik no, full card numbers or phone numbers; the pino redact list in src/server/log.ts must be updated when adding PII fields
Login and /api/payments are rate limited with @upstash/ratelimit (10 req/min per IP) in middleware.ts
iyzico checkout form was blocked by CSP; added *.iyzipay.com to frame-src and script-src in next.config.mjs headers
Home page uses ISR revalidate 300; category pages are dynamic because of stock badges
Prefer React Server Components for data fetching; client components only for interactivity (cart drawer, filters)
Secrets live in fly secrets (flyctl secrets set) and GitHub Actions secrets; .env.example lists every variable, .env.local is gitignored
NEXT_PUBLIC_ variables are inlined at build time; changing them in fly secrets needs a rebuild, not just a restart
Turborepo monorepo: apps/web, apps/admin, packages/ui, packages/db; shared Prisma client lives in packages/db
Admin panel (apps/admin) is a separate Next app behind Cloudflare Access; only @kervan.com.tr Google accounts
CSV export of orders for muhasebe (accounting) requested by Elif; needs e-fatura number column
sitemap.ts generates product URLs in chunks of 5000; robots disallows /sepet and /hesap
Product slugs are Turkish-transliterated (ç->c, ğ->g, ı->i) via slugify in src/lib/slug.ts; old slugs 301 via ProductSlugHistory
Kargo entegrasyonu Yurtiçi Kargo API ile; takip numarası Order.trackingCode alanında, webhook yok, her saat cron ile durum çekiliyor
trackShipments cron hit Yurtiçi rate limits; batched to 50 per request and added 1s delay
Prices are KDV dahil (VAT included, 20%); invoice.ts splits net and KDV for e-arşiv fatura via Paraşüt API
Paraşüt API tokens expire every 2 hours; the client refreshes on 401 but the refresh token itself lasts only 7 days without use
TypeScript strict everywhere; no any — use unknown and narrow with zod
Kullanıcıya Türkçe yanıt ver, kod ve commit mesajları İngilizce
Session: started partial refund support; added RefundRequest model, UI button on order detail; tests not written yet
Session: fixed avatar hydration mismatch (useAuthStore skipHydration); ran pnpm test, all green
Session: stabilised checkout e2e, removed networkidle waits, CI green 5 runs in a row
Session: Yurtiçi kargo takip cron'u batch'lendi, rate limit hataları bitti
Session: added composite index on orders(userId, createdAt); explored Neon branching for e2e
fly.io app kervan-web runs in ams; the queue worker is the "worker" process group in fly.toml
Node version: 20 LTS (.nvmrc), required by next 14.2 and Prisma 5
State management: zustand stores in src/stores, one store per concern (useAuthStore, useCartStore, useUIStore)
Product images are served from S3 eu-central-1 bucket kervan-media via CloudFront
Elif wants the campaign banner (Black Friday / Efsane Cuma) ready by 20 Nov; banner content comes from the admin CMS table Banner
Feature flags are rows in the FeatureFlag table read via isEnabled('new-checkout'); cached 60s in memory
New one-page checkout behind the new-checkout flag; old 3-step checkout removed after 2 weeks of A/B
Analytics: Plausible self-hosted (no cookie banner needed); events via track('add_to_cart', props)
Meilisearch on fly needs a volume (meili_data) and a single machine; scaling to 2 machines splits the index
Mobile Lighthouse on product page is 71; biggest items are the iyzico script and the reviews widget
Daily report cron ran at 03:00 Istanbul instead of 06:00 because BullMQ repeat uses UTC; set tz: 'Europe/Istanbul'
Only customers with a delivered order can review a product; reviews are moderated in admin before publishing
Server actions for mutations from forms; route handlers only for webhooks and third-party callbacks; no tRPC
Kupon kodları büyük/küçük harf duyarsız, tek kullanımlık kuponlar CouponRedemption tablosunda unique (couponId,userId)
Percentage coupons round each line separately so totals can be 1 kuruş off from the summary
Log zero-result searches to find missing synonyms

pulsar.text: Releases are GitOps: CI builds the image and bumps image.tag in deploy/helm/pulsar/values-prod.yaml, ArgoCD syncs it to GKE; nobody runs kubectl apply or helm upgrade by hand — Decided after an incident where a hand-run helm upgrade used a stale values file and dropped the HPA. ArgoCD auto-sync is on for staging, manual sync button for prod.
Prod ArgoCD app is pulsar-prod in the argocd namespace; sync is manual, staging (pulsar-staging) auto-syncs from main
Pods were killed during rollout because the readiness probe hit /health before Alembic finished; added a separate migration Job (pre-sync hook) and /ready endpoint
Release tag'leri vYYYY.MM.DD-N formatında; prod sync'ten önce #pulsar-releases kanalına changelog yazılır
Canary: set canary.weight in values-prod.yaml (Argo Rollouts), 10% for 30 min, watch p99 in Grafana before promoting

PG_POOL_MAX: 40 per pod since the move to Cloud SQL Enterprise Plus (max_connections 800); keep pods*PG_POOL_MAX under 600 — Raised from 20 after connection-acquire timeouts during the Monday batch import. 12 pods * 40 = 480.
SQLAlchemy 2.0 async ORM with asyncpg driver; raw SQL only in src/pulsar/queries/ for reporting queries
Every schema change is an Alembic revision generated with alembic revision --autogenerate and then hand-reviewed; never edit an applied revision
Autogenerate kept emitting drop/create for enum types; fixed by compare_type=False and handling enums manually with op.execute
Adding a NOT NULL column with default on the events_raw table locks it for minutes; add nullable, backfill in batches, then set NOT NULL
Pods connect to Cloud SQL through the cloud-sql-proxy sidecar on 127.0.0.1:5432; local dev uses docker compose postgres:16
Raw events go to ClickHouse (MergeTree partitioned by toYYYYMM(ts)); Postgres keeps only accounts, projects and API keys — Postgres events table hit 2B rows and aggregations took minutes.
ClickHouse inserts are batched: flush every 5000 rows or 2s, whichever first (writer.py); single-row inserts create too many parts
"Too many parts" errors on ClickHouse after deploy: two writers per pod; fixed by making the writer a singleton per process
ClickHouse TTL for events is 13 months; GDPR delete uses ALTER TABLE ... DELETE which is async (mutation), check system.mutations
One APIRouter per resource in src/pulsar/api/<resource>.py; request/response models in schemas.py with Pydantic v2, never return ORM objects directly
API keys are shown once, stored as argon2id hash plus an 8-char prefix (pk_live_abcd1234) for lookup
API versioned in the URL (/v1, /v2); v1 is frozen, breaking changes only in v2
Rate limit is 1000 req/min per API key using a Redis sliding window; returns 429 with Retry-After
422 errors for timestamps with Z suffix after the Pydantic v2 upgrade; switched field type to AwareDatetime
Replace offset pagination on /v2/events with cursor pagination (offset > 10k times out)
CORS preflight fails for the dashboard on the staging domain; allow_origins is missing https://app.staging.pulsar.dev
Dashboard auth uses short-lived JWTs (15 min) with rotating refresh tokens stored hashed in Postgres; reuse of a refresh token revokes the whole family
JWT signing keys rotate monthly; public keys served at /.well-known/jwks.json, kid in header
Background jobs: Celery with Redis broker; queues default, reports, exports; workers deployed as pulsar-worker deployment
Export workers OOMKilled on large CSV exports; now stream rows with yield_per(5000) and write to GCS in chunks, plus worker_max_tasks_per_child=50
Celery beat must run as exactly one replica; two beat pods sent every scheduled report twice
Görevler idempotent olmalı: her task bir idempotency_key alır ve tamamlananlar task_runs tablosuna yazılır
Tests with pytest + pytest-asyncio, run in parallel with pytest -n auto; integration tests marked @pytest.mark.integration and need docker compose up
Each test runs in a transaction rolled back at the end (conftest.py db_session fixture); ClickHouse tests use a per-worker database pulsar_test_gw0..N
"Event loop is closed" flakes with pytest-xdist; fixed by setting asyncio_mode=auto and scope="session" loop fixture
Test data via factory_boy factories in tests/factories.py (AccountFactory, ApiKeyFactory, EventFactory)
Dependency management with uv (uv.lock committed); poetry removed; add deps with uv add, never pip install into the venv
ruff for lint+format (line length 100) and mypy --strict on src/; pre-commit runs both
mypy complained about missing stubs for clickhouse-connect; added it to ignore_missing_imports override instead of type: ignore everywhere
Python version: 3.12 (.python-version), the Docker base image is python:3.12-slim
Tracing with OpenTelemetry SDK exporting OTLP to Grafana Tempo; metrics via Prometheus /metrics scraped by Grafana Agent
Grafana dashboard "Pulsar / Ingest" shows events/s, ClickHouse flush latency and Celery queue depth; alerts route to #pulsar-alerts
Logs were not correlated with traces; added trace_id/span_id to the structlog JSON processor
Logging via structlog JSON only, no print(); log keys snake_case, never log raw API keys or event payloads
Ingest path: POST /v1/track -> validate -> enqueue in Redis stream events:in -> writer pods batch to ClickHouse; the API never writes to ClickHouse directly
Redis Streams instead of Kafka for the ingest buffer: volume is ~3k events/s, Kafka ops cost not justified; revisit above 20k/s
Redis memory spiked when ClickHouse was slow; added MAXLEN ~ 5,000,000 on XADD and a 503 when stream lag exceeds 2M
Client timestamps can be days in the future (bad phone clocks); clamp ts to server time + 5 min and keep the original in client_ts
API pods: requests 500m CPU / 512Mi, limits 1 CPU / 1Gi; HPA 4–12 replicas at 65% CPU
API pods OOM after a week: gunicorn workers leaked; now uvicorn workers=2 with --limit-max-requests 10000
Secrets come from Google Secret Manager via External Secrets Operator; never put secrets in values files
GKE node pool switched to spot VMs for workers (not API) to cut cost ~45%; workers must tolerate preemption
IP addresses are truncated to /24 (IPv4) and /48 (IPv6) before storage for GDPR; full IP is never written
Secrets must never be committed; gitleaks runs in pre-commit and CI, a hit fails the build
Webhook URLs could target internal IPs (SSRF); now resolved and blocked for private ranges before sending
Outgoing webhooks are signed with HMAC-SHA256 header X-Pulsar-Signature, retried with exponential backoff up to 8 times over ~24h
Weekly reports rendered with WeasyPrint to PDF and emailed via Postmark every Monday 08:00 Europe/Istanbul
Turkish characters (ş, ğ, İ) rendered as boxes in PDF reports; installed fonts-dejavu in the Docker image
Billing via Stripe Billing with metered usage; usage reported hourly from ClickHouse counts, not per event
Stripe webhooks can arrive out of order; always re-fetch the subscription from Stripe instead of trusting the event payload
Send a usage warning email at 80% of the plan quota
Project settings cached in Redis for 60s with key proj:{id}:settings; invalidate on PATCH /v2/projects/{id}
Local setup: make dev starts postgres, redis, clickhouse via docker compose and runs uvicorn --reload on :8000
clickhouse image on Apple Silicon needs platform: linux/arm64 and ulimits nofile 262144 or it exits silently
Session: started cursor pagination for /v2/events, wrote encode/decode cursor helpers, tests failing on ordering ties
Session: raised PG_POOL_MAX to 40 after acquire timeouts; checked Cloud SQL max_connections
Session: added XADD MAXLEN and 503 backpressure on ingest; load-tested at 8k events/s
Session: logs ile trace'ler birleştirildi, structlog'a trace_id eklendi
`pytest -n auto` failed (AssertionError: 422 != 200) → fixed via src/pulsar/api/schemas.py
`alembic upgrade head` failed (DuplicateObject: type "plan_tier" already exists) → fixed via alembic/versions/0042_add_retention.py
`pytest tests/tasks` failed (MemoryError) → fixed via src/pulsar/tasks/exports.py
`docker build .` failed (uv: lockfile out of date) → fixed via uv.lock Dockerfile
Run tests in parallel with pytest -n auto; integration tests are marked integration and require docker compose services
API rate limiting: 1000 requests per minute per key, Redis sliding window, 429 + Retry-After header
